reason: real Marko rejects a lowercase local-variable tag reference outright ("Local variables must be in a [dynamic tag](https://markojs.com/docs/reference/language#dynamic-tags) unless they are PascalCase. Use `<${layout}/>` or rename to `Layout`.") -- verified against @marko/compiler 5.42.11 / marko@6.4.4. Since the lowercase-local-component rule moved into core, every target rejects the same reference with that same Marko message, verbatim and at the tag name; both sides name the `<${layout}/>` dynamic-tag fix, which is what this pattern matches. See fixtures dynamic-tag-lowercase-import and nested-layout for the two forms that still work: `<${layout}/>` and `<Layout/>`.
